data.definition: Studies that adapt or validate questionnaires to assess engineering students' perceptions of their internship or work experiences, focusing on factors like workplace support, university support, and the development of generic competencies.

Research that develops or validates instruments to measure constructs related to entrepreneurial mindset (e.g., connections, creating value) or design mindset (e.g., iteration, co-creation) in engineering education contexts.

Studies that examine the psychometric properties of instruments measuring grit (perseverance and passion for long-term goals) and engineering mindset (iterative, failure-tolerant approach) using advanced statistical methods such as SEM and IRT.

data.theme: Competence Assessment in Mathematics and Engineering Fundamentals
data.definition: Studies that develop or validate instruments to assess engineering students' competences in foundational areas such as mathematics, vector calculus, or basic electronics skills, often using Rasch analysis or rubric-based approaches.
